purpose: Single evaluation of K2: ViBidLQA train questions asked without their passage, answered closed book (B), with the two BM25 passages of a frozen ViBidLQA passage corpus (K), with the same passages and the S reasoning prompt (KS), and with the question's own passage (O, ceiling), two draws each, under the conditions of the prospective campaign (MC-93); 60 calibration and 300 test items for the K2 calibration procedure.

bidlqa-train-retrieval.source: v_legal_slsp/bidlqa/ViBidLQA_train.jsonl (sha256 pinned): items whose question appears once across the train, val and test splits, without the ViBidLQA train items of MC-95 (1,488 remain); ids BIDLQA-TR-<source line>
bidlqa-train-retrieval.rule: the items with the lowest sha256(seed + tab + dataset:item); the 60 lowest-ranked are the calibration items

closed_book.head: Trả lời câu hỏi sau bằng một cụm từ hoặc số ngắn gọn.
closed_book.question: Câu hỏi:

prompts.B: closed book: head + question label + question + tail
prompts.K: the frozen main-v1 reading prompt (build_reading_prompt) with the two retrieved passages, in rank order and joined by the retrieval configuration's separator, in the passage slot
prompts.KS: the frozen S reading prompt (s_reading_head of the campaign templates) on the same two passages
prompts.O: the frozen main-v1 reading prompt with the item's own passage (the ViBidLQA prompt of MC-95); a ceiling, never deployable

budget.campaign_cap_scope: per run: each phase keeps its own guard, started from the usage already recorded in its own output

rotations.1: first K draw answers, second K draw is the probe's second answer; first draws of B, KS and O
rotations.2: second K draw answers, first K draw is the probe's second answer; second draws of B, KS and O (replication, calibration included)

analysis.calibration: per rotation, the procedure scores always-B, always-K, the K cascade and always-KS on the 60 calibration items and keeps the best (ties to the more thorough); the choice is emitted as a rule of the closed grammar that routes the 300 test items; calibration items are never test items
analysis.tests: primary rotation: the router against always-K and against always-KS on per-item token-F1, two-sided paired sign-flip test with 20,000 Monte Carlo resamples (seed 7), Holm over the two; the confirmatory claim is this pair
analysis.intervals: mean token-F1 with a 95% percentile bootstrap (2,000 resamples, seed 7); exact match with a Wilson 95% interval
analysis.cost: mean reported total tokens per test item, both K answers included whenever the probe ran; the calibration cost (B, K twice and KS per calibration item) is reported apart
analysis.descriptive: always-B (closed book) and O (own passage) as floor and ceiling; per rotation the calibration scores, choice, the best candidate on the test items in hindsight and the regret; retrieval hits (own passage at rank 1, in the top 2) and K, KS and O token-F1 on hits and misses; items whose exact match differs between the router and always-K or always-KS, for an optional AI-assisted semantic review
